definitions.text: Right and left pedicle diameter ratios in APEX±1 and NV ± 1; columns: Variables |  | APEX ±1 | NV ±1 | p-values. *Statistically significant. APEX±1 the region of the apical vertebra and its two adjacent vertebrae; Lt.H/Rt.H left/right pedicle height of the cortical bone; Lt.h/Rt.h left/right pedicle height of the cancellous bone; Lt.W/Rt.W left/right pedicle width of the cortical bone; Lt.w/Rt.w left/right pedicle width of the cancellous bone; NV ± 1 the region of the NV and its two adjacent vertebrae

Ratios are left/right; the paper states left is concave and right convex. Table 3 is retained independently of Table 2: no ratio is recomputed from Table 2 means. Apex cortical-width ratio retains the original note P7 explicit SD label; other ± statistics remain unlabelled. Apex cortical-height ratio 0.86 ± 0.52 (0.75–0.97) is retained as a probable misprint, not used.
